business.name: X-Traordinary Development
business.author: Xavier Thurman
business.location: Minneapolis, MN (also serving Miami, FL and clients across the US)
business.description: A Black-owned custom software and web development studio. We hand-code websites (no page builders), build web applications, internal tools, customer portals, and AI systems (.NET, React/Next.js, Angular, Python), and take over/modernize existing codebases. Fixed-price proposals, clients own their code.

audience: Owners and operators of small and mid-size businesses and nonprofits – contractors, clinics, professional services, restaurants, event organizers, B2B companies – who are deciding about a website, a software project, or AI, and want a straight answer without jargon.
tone: Plain English, direct, specific, warm but not salesy. Short paragraphs. Concrete examples. Honest about trade-offs, including when the answer is 'you don't need us'. Never hype, never clickbait, no exclamation points.
approvedFacts: Based in Minneapolis, MN; also serves Miami, FL; works remotely nationwide.
Black-owned business rooted in the Minneapolis community.
Websites are hand-coded – no templates, no page builders. Clients own the code, content, and domain.
Every project is quoted as a fixed price with a written scope before work starts.
Stack: .NET/C#, React/Next.js, Angular, Python, SQL Server/PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS/Vercel.
Enterprise engineering experience on internal applications at U.S. Bank and CHS Inc.
Built FundStart AI, a custom AI/RAG research platform for the AEC industry.
Built GridLink, a full-stack procurement platform for enterprise fuel buying.

Live client sites: Works of Heart (worksofheart.us – gala & art auction for Saint John's Abbey), The R3D Key (trk-contracting.com – Minnesota general contractor), Plates & Playmakers (platesandplaymakers.com – Minneapolis charity gala), Low Fuel (low-fuel.com – mobile fueling company), VSC Peptides (research peptide e-commerce).
neverClaim: Do not state any of our prices, price ranges, hourly rates, or timelines as facts. Market ranges attributed to 'typical' industry pricing are fine; our own pricing is not.
Do not invent statistics, percentages, survey results, or study citations. If a number is needed, phrase it as a general observation without a figure.
Do not name clients, awards, certifications, partners, or team members other than those in approvedFacts.
Do not make guarantees about rankings, revenue, or results.
Do not mention competitors by name.
